briefdescription.para: Instantiate InterfacesExactDerivativeCalculator.

detaileddescription.para: It creates a dense matrix, a vector for the rhs and a vector for the solution. The matrix is initialised with the InterfaceDerivCoeffs given in input and factorised with a LU decomposition. The InterfaceDerivCoeffs are stored by reference. They must outlive this object.

parameterdescription.para: MultipatchType collection of index ranges defined on the given list of patches.
The InterfaceDerivCoeffs for each inner interface in the given Grid1D direction (i.e. excluding interfaces with an OutsideEdge). They can be given in any order.

memberdef.definition: void InterfacesExactDerivativeCalculator< Connectivity, Grid1D, LowerBound, UpperBound >::operator()
memberdef.name: operator()

briefdescription.para: Solve the matrix system (I-M)S = C to determine all the interface derivatives or cross-derivatives in the Grid1D direction at a given index.

detaileddescription.para: For the derivatives, it uses the function values to compute the first-derivatives perpendicular to the interfaces. For the cross-derivatives, it uses the first-derivatives to compute the cross-derivatives in a perpendicular direction to the interfaces.

parameterdescription.para: Type for the given derivative order, either on the perpendicular direction for the first derivatives or both for the cross-derivatives.
Type for the given index. It can be on the first or the second grid of the first patch.
Indicate if we compute the first derivatives or the cross-derivatives. Its value is not taken into account.
Collection fields with its first derivatives and cross-derivatives.
Index of the line in the Grid1D direction where we compute all the interface derivatives.

memberdef.name: operator()

briefdescription.para: Solve the matrix system MS = C to determine all the interface derivatives in the Grid1D direction at all the indices of the first patch, or all the corner cross-derivatives in the Grid1D direction at all the last and the first indices of the first patch.

detaileddescription.para: For the derivatives, it uses the function values to compute the first-derivatives perpendicular to the interfaces. For the cross-derivatives, it uses the first-derivatives to compute the cross-derivatives in a perpendicular direction to the interfaces.

parameterdescription.para: Type for the given derivative order, either on the perpendicular direction for the first derivatives or both for the cross-derivatives.
Indicate if we compute the first derivatives or the cross-derivatives. Its value is not taken into account.
Collection fields with its first derivatives and cross-derivatives we want to compute.

simplesect.para: The global mesh is supposed to be conforming.

briefdescription.para: Transform a boolean into a integer. If true, the sign is positive. If false, the sign is negative.
Class to compute the interface derivatives along a given direction on all the interfaces.

detaileddescription.para: This operator is implemented for conforming equivalent global meshes. It uses the exact formula.

During the instantiation of the class, the matrix (I-M) is computed are stored in the class. When we call operator():
InterfacesExactDerivativeCalculator computes the vector C from the given values.
It inverses the matrix system: (I-M)S = C.
The interface derivatives are stored in the vector S.
It updates the given derivatives field with the values of the vector S.

parameterdescription.para: A MultipatchConnectivity class describing all the patch connections.
Lower/left boundary condition of the first local spline along the given direction.
Upper/right boundary condition of the last local spline along the given direction.
